title: OwnershipTransfer
description: A change of holder. Vehicle identity and history survive the transfer intact: the new holder gains access to the vehicle-level record, gains NO access to the previous holder's personal data, and can never delete, hide, edit or reset prior history. Holders are referenced pseudonymously — no personal data is embedded here, which is what makes a holder erasure possible without destroying the vehicle's history.

from_holder_ref.description: Opaque, non-resolving pseudonymous reference. Becomes a dangling non-resolving reference after a holder erasure — the transfer record itself survives.

supersedes.description: The id of a prior OwnershipTransfer record this one corrects. A transfer recorded in error (wrong holder, wrong date, wrong type) is corrected by recording a new transfer that supersedes it, never by deleting or editing the original — OVIP §9.3 forbids a new holder (or anyone else) deleting, hiding, editing or resetting prior history, and §4 forbids silently overwriting any historical fact. The superseded record MUST remain retrievable.
